boards.name: Office for National Statistics
boards.notes: Homepage offers English and Cymraeg. The About page names the UK Statistics Authority as the body it serves as executive office. Contact page lists offices in Newport, Titchfield, London, Darlington, Manchester, Edinburgh and Belfast; no headquarters is named. The /developers page returned 404.

sources.title: About ONS
sources.quote: We are the executive office of the UK Statistics Authority

sources.title: Office locations
sources.quote: Details of our offices in Newport, Titchfield, London, Darlington, Manchester, Edinburgh and Belfast.

boards.name: Freelancer.com
boards.business_model: free to post a project; 3% fee charged to employer on accepted jobs
boards.notes: Homepage footer language selector shows only US (International) / English. The API page says posting is free and describes a 3% charge on accepted jobs. The API page does not state whether a key is needed. The /partners page returned 404. No headquarters or parent is stated on the pages read.

sources.title: Freelancer API page
sources.quote: If a job is accepted, we charge 3% to the employer with no minimum project fee.

sources.title: Freelancer API page
sources.quote: Use the Freelancer API to access a cloud workforce of skilled freelancers from your website, app or software.

sources.title: Freelancer API page
sources.quote: Hire in any profession you can think of using our API, on demand

boards.name: Jobware
boards.notes: Homepage and employer page are in German with no language selector shown. The employer page names a network of partner platforms for reach, which is not a partner program for integrations. No prices, headquarters, parent, API or posting method were stated on the pages read. Footer names Jobware GmbH without an address.

boards.name: Cadremploi
boards.notes: Fetch tool could not reach the site; the browser reader loaded it without a block. The footer links Groupe Figaro, but the page does not state the relationship. Employer area offers posting a job; no prices or API are stated. Page is in French with no language selector shown.

boards.name: Nomis
boards.notes: Nomis describes itself as a labour market statistics service. The API page documents a RESTful API for data downloads and states a limit on concurrent requests; it does not state whether a key is needed. The contact page names no address. No language options, prices or partner program were stated on the pages read.

sources.title: Homepage
sources.quote: Nomis is a service provided by Office for National Statistics (ONS)

sources.title: Nomis API page
sources.quote: This is the Nomis RESTful API you can use it to perform a variety of structural discovery and data download requests.

boards.name: Gi Group Holding
boards.notes: Footer gives the headquarters as Milano and the company as GI GROUP HOLDING S.p.A. The country is Italy from the Milan address and the Milan companies register named in the footer. Country selector only; no language options shown. No pricing, API or partner program was stated on the pages read.

boards.name: Kwork
boards.notes: Homepage read in the browser; no language selector, company location, parent or pricing for employers was stated. The /api page returned 404.

boards.name: Beamery
boards.notes: Partners page offers joining the partner network and lists certified SAP and Workday integrations. Homepage, partners page and about page make no mention of a public API. The /developers page returned 404. No headquarters, parent, languages or pricing were stated; the only call to action is Book a demo.

sources.title: Partners page
sources.quote: Our integration allows mutual customers to bidirectionally sync candidate and vacancy data in real-time between the Beamery CRM and Greenhouse ATS.

boards.name: LHH
boards.notes: Homepage language selector shows only United States (English). Footer links The Adecco Group but does not state the relationship. Locations page says talent solutions span 66 countries without naming a headquarters. No pricing, API or partner program was stated on the pages read.

boards.name: Jobscan
boards.notes: Browser reader returned a Cloudflare challenge page with HTTP 403 and flagged the site as blocked. No facts recorded from this board.
